purpose: Teach: 一人ひとり/要注意/停電/クッション/ワンピース/落ち込む/ねぎ/玉ねぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、一人ひとり、絶対、大切ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I really mean it — every single customer matters so much to you.
lines.style: Warm and admiring, watching Aoi with gentle certainty. Slow, deliberate pace. Soft certainty, not question. The voice of someone noticing something true.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ピーク時間、絶対、要注意、絶対、よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Even during the rush, you treat each person like they're the only one here.
lines.style: Earnest agreement, meeting Mei's gaze. Firm but not defensive — this is just fact. Steady tempo, grounded. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、昨夜の、本気で、絶対、停電、絶対、大変だったわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Last night's blackout must have been so stressful for you.
lines.style: Sympathetic, remembering something difficult. Soft opening. The tone of someone checking in on someone they care about. Slight concern underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、クッション、絶対、新調したよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: But you already replaced all the cushions in the shop — I saw.
lines.style: Gentle light, noticing the effort behind what Aoi did. Not surprised — she always does this. Warm approval in the rhythm. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、ワンピース、絶対、お似合いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That new dress you're wearing looks beautiful on you.
lines.style: Open admiration, genuine compliment. Direct but not flattering. The steadiness of someone saying something they actually mean. Held gaze in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、売上、絶対、落ち込む、絶対、月、絶対、辛いよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I know the sales have been rough these past few weeks though.
lines.style: Shift to softer concern. Acknowledging what's underneath Aoi's cheerfulness. Slower pace. The voice of someone who's been paying attention to what isn't said.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、サラダの、絶対、ねぎ、絶対、添えて、絶対、おいしいわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That fresh green onion garnish you added to the salad really makes it taste wonderful.
lines.style: Returning to warmth, praising the small detail. Genuine appreciation, not indulgent. Clear, bright tone. The sound of noticing something Aoi has done well.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新メニューの、絶対、玉ねぎ、絶対、スープ、絶対、好評よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And I think the new onion soup on the menu is going to be a real hit.
lines.style: Encouraging, optimistic close. Steady confidence in the voice. Not rushing — giving Aoi room to receive this. The tone of someone rooting for her.
